description: Check the HARMONY of notes before rendering or placing them: factor a MIDI progression into its sonorities (mode "midi", default — chord-detection-free: each segment of simultaneously sounding pitches reduced to an anchor pitch class + register-exact shape, covered with recurring shape cells) or into chord symbols (mode "chord": one estimated chord per ~2 beats + a corpus-grammar cell cover with a schedule). Input: notes[] (the rows you would give doseedo_render_midi / set_midi_notes) with bpm, or midi_url (a .mid ≤2 MiB: a doseedo result link such as a stem's MIDI, or a public URL). Synchronous (~2–10 s), CPU, no credits. Returns sonorities[] or chords[], cover, cells, compression — read chords[].chord / sonorities[].anchor to confirm the key and progression you intended. Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

beats_per_segment.description: mode chord: segment length in beats (0.25–8, default 2).

bpm.description: Tempo of the notes (needed with notes; default 120).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

midi_url.description: Alternative to notes: https URL of a Standard MIDI File (≤2 MiB).

min_seg_beats.description: mode midi: shortest sonority segment in beats (default 0.25).

mode.description: "midi" (default): sonority / shape factoring. "chord": chord symbols per segment + cell cover.

notes.description: The notes to analyze, in beats from bar 1 (same rows as doseedo_render_midi). Needs bpm.

name: doseedo_analyze_midi
